Carly — great, Aug 8 9:00am PT works for our team. Attaching a draft kickoff agenda and our proposed attendee roster. Monica will lead the session and Marissa will cover technical onboarding steps and next milestones.

Proposed agenda (60m):
1) 5m – Introductions & objectives (Rafael)
2) 10m – Product overview & success criteria (Carly + Inovexa)
3) 15m – Redwood implementation approach & timeline (Monica)
4) 15m – Technical preflight and integration checklist (Marissa + Kimberly)
5) 10m – Next steps, ownership, and follow-ups (Ben)

Preflight recommendation: a 30-minute technical readiness run-through with your IT (recommended Aug 6 or Aug 7). That call will cover network egress, VPN/VPC notes, KMS access patterns, and test API keys.

I'll send a calendar invite once we confirm the IT attendee.

Thanks,
Rafael Mendes
Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
